name: Grand Coalition Against Tyranny
description: Free cities and sovereign realms form a grand military coalition to withstand an encroaching dark empire.
creativePrompt: What supreme allied commander was elected to lead the disparate armies under one banner?
exampleNarrative: Under the banner of the silver chalice, seven free kingdoms united their banners in solemn council of war.

name: Continental Famine Relief Convoy
description: Prosperous farming realms send hundreds of wagonloads of grain to save a drought-stricken rival province.
creativePrompt: How did this act of generosity dissolve a century of hostility between the two peoples?
exampleNarrative: When locusts devoured the southern harvest, the northern clans sent three hundred wagons of flour to save their starving neighbors.

name: Post-War Reconstruction Accord
description: Allied architects, stonemasons, and engineers deploy together to rebuild a war-shattered border province.
creativePrompt: What shared memorial monument was erected in the rebuilt city square?
exampleNarrative: Masons from both sides of the mountains laboured together to rebuild the ruined bridges and raise new homes from the ashes.

name: Joint Free-Company Highway Patrol
description: Neighboring realms fund a neutral order of rangers and knights to eradicate bandits and monsters from trade roads.
creativePrompt: What oath of strict political neutrality is sworn by the road wardens?
exampleNarrative: Wearing the green tabards of the Road Wardens, knights patrolled the wilderness pass ensuring travelers reached safety.

name: Great Continental Atlas Expedition
description: Naturalists and cartographers from four species journey together into uncharted lands to publish a global atlas.
creativePrompt: What uncharted mountain passes or deep ocean trenches did the joint expedition discover?
exampleNarrative: Dwarven surveyors, human naturalists, and elven navigators compiled the definitive Great Atlas of the Known Realms.

name: Inter-Faith Conclave of Peace
description: High priests of competing solar, lunar, and elemental faiths sign an edict of mutual respect and religious tolerance.
creativePrompt: What joint temple was consecrated where priests of all three orders pray beneath one roof?
exampleNarrative: In a historic ceremony, the high pontiffs extinguished the torches of holy war and blessed each other in the name of the creator.

name: Plague Quarantine & Healers League
description: An international circle of apothecaries sets up cordons, sanitariums, and distribues cures for the red pestilence.
creativePrompt: Which courageous physician discovered the herbal tincture that halted the contagion?
exampleNarrative: Braving contagion, masked apothecaries established clean sanitariums that saved thousands from the pestilence.

name: Fellowship of the World-Beacon
description: Champions from every species unite on a mythic quest to relight the ancient celestial ward holding back the void.
creativePrompt: What sacred relics did each champion carry to the pinnacle of the world to relight the fire?
exampleNarrative: Bound by a fellowship stronger than crowns, nine champions scaled the highest glacier to kindle the ancient sky-beacon.
